subject: general
question: Who received the CSIR Young Scientist Award in 2021 (a scheme of Awards for Young Scientists in the CSIR system to promote excellence in various fields of science and technology)?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Dr. K Giribabu**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Dr. K. Giribabu**, Scientist, **CSIR-CECRI, Karaikudi** has been selected for **"CSIR Young Scientist Award"** for the year 2021 in the field of** Chemical Sciences **for his outstanding contributions.
 
• The award will be presented to him on** 26thSeptember, 2021 **in CSIR Foundation Day Celebration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dr. K. Giribabu hails from an agricultural family in **Arungundram village, Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu.**
 
• After his initial schooling at **Sri Ramakrishna Mission Boys Higher Secondary School**, Chengalpattu, he did his B.Sc. (Chemistry) from Rajeswari Vedachalam Govt. Arts College, Chengalpattu, M.Sc. (Chemistry) [Gold Medalist] from the University of Madras and M. Phil. in Analytical Chemistry.
 
• During his M.Sc. days, he received the Prof. PBJ award for two consecutive years for his outstanding academic performance.
 
• He pursued his Doctoral Research in Inorganic Chemistry at the University of Madras and Postdoctoral Research at the Department of Biological Engineering, Inha University, South Korea.
 
• **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR):**
 
 
• A **modern R&D organisation** is the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), which is renowned for its cutting edge R&D knowledge base in several S&T fields. 
 
• **37 national laboratories, 39 outreach centres,** 1 innovation complex, and 3 units with a pan-India presence make up the dynamic network of the CSIR.
 
• As of the end of March 2022, the CSIR's R&D experience and expertise were represented by over** 3521 active scientists** who were backed by about 4162 technical and support staff.
 
• In many societal endeavours, such as the environment, **health, drinking water, food, housing, energy, farm and non-farm sectors**, it offers substantial technical involvement. 
 
• The CSIR's contribution to the growth of **S&T human resources** is also important.
